notes: Address. The prefatory note says: 'These Addresses are not to be regarded as exhaustive, but suggestive.' (1884) No text is stated. Opening words: “In the fifteenth chapter of John and the seventh verse, we find who have their prayers answered—“If ye abide in Me, and My words abide in you, ye shall ask …” No single text is announced. The opening sentence sets John 15:7 ('In the fifteenth chapter of John and the seventh verse') beside James 4:3. The chapter also runs on into the publisher's notice and book list that end the volume.
